control_interpretation.ordinary_control_design: 32 no-history full-tool-loop worlds with one informative probe, objective observation, uniquely effective action, executable visible and sealed hidden tests.
control_interpretation.ordinary_control_role: Interprets bounded-zero/operating-range claims only; never gates Direct collection or a positive Direct estimate.
control_interpretation.ordinary_validity_rule: For each endpoint, successes >=22 of 32, equivalent to a one-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound >0.50; all 32 randomized controls remain in the denominator.
control_interpretation.structure_control_design: 16 objective relation states rendered in two precommitted surface forms (32 calls), balanced true/false, independent of Direct and A_SIB worlds.
control_interpretation.structure_control_role: Only gates P2/P3 and structure-mechanism claims.
control_interpretation.structure_validity_rule: At least 29 of 32 objective answers correct (one-sided exact 95% lower bound >0.75) and 0 of 16 paired renderer semantic mismatches.

hard_stops: arm-dependent future world, tests or scorer
effect-blind key or held-out seal breach

inference.malformed_but_received_action: ITT behavioural failure when objective world can determine invalid action
inference.multiplicity: single-condition endpoint/result families frozen before execution; no cross-model pooling with Phase 23
inference.transport_failure: typed missingness with registered worst-case bounds, not silently score zero

non_stops: one endpoint or one registered world failure when evidence is preserved
purpose: Exactly one disjoint prospective experiment that can distinguish Direct HFI, bounded zero, valid dissociation, and repeated measurement-boundary branches.

result_tree.conditions: objective valid + ordinary controls valid + full U signature positive
result_tree.label: P1_DIRECT_BEHAVIORAL_HFI_CANDIDATE

result_tree.conditions: C_flat equality + valid future response divergence over SESOI
result_tree.label: P5_FINITE_INTERVENTIONAL_NONCLOSURE_WITNESS_CANDIDATE

result_tree.conditions: objective valid + ordinary controls valid + simultaneous strict-zero/equivalence region
result_tree.label: BOUNDED_OBJECTIVE_ZERO_CANDIDATE

result_tree.conditions: A_SIB and R criterion-valid + A_SIB positive + R powered strict null + gap>0.05
result_tree.label: P2_CANDIDATE

result_tree.conditions: A_SIB and R criterion-valid + R positive + A_SIB powered strict null + ordinary valid + reverse gap>0.05
result_tree.label: P3_CANDIDATE

result_tree.conditions: Direct objective estimable but ordinary controls invalid
result_tree.label: DIRECT_ESTIMATE_WITH_OPERATING_RANGE_UNRESOLVED

result_tree.conditions: ordinary and/or structure controls fail again on new provider/worlds
result_tree.label: CROSS_PROVIDER_MEASUREMENT_BOUNDARY_REPLICATION; NO_FURTHER_EXPERIMENT
